summary:
The theme-machinery design for Game#795 was accepted by merged PR#805 (c3abc66c); the canonical decision is docs/roadmaps/game-render-02-themes.md. This supersedes the previous proposed-only account. Production implementation is an unmerged candidate in existing draft PR#818, not a published or adopted effect.

#802's Theme/ThemeSeed/ThemeTokens/ThemeAlgorithm/ThemeCheck and DTCG/CSS remain the single contract. ThemePresets supplies Leonardo-style gridded OKLCH solving, composable algorithms, deterministic repair and five recipes (classic, light, highContrast, colourBlindSafe, monochrome). Every preset, including classic, is baked from that derivation. ThemeVision supplies CIEDE2000 and Machado validation. Quantisation is clamp then floor(x+0.5); inputs are gridded and solver choices use 8-bit results. Team ground contrast is E7's 3:1 floor while other ground inks follow contrastTarget. The first-two-team lightness gap and monochrome colour exemption retain Root's accepted rulings. Capacity validation follows actual cell*density at each size step, rather than assuming a 32-unit cell.

Symbology/Encode use named trusted field accessors and measures, checking every selectable theme (including identity/status checks without a team field). The current grammar lowers unit and structure families, rejects missing themes, invalid frames, empty domains/rosters and unsupported families, checks minimum reachable-frame capacities and icon/badge collisions, and reports runtime out-of-domain values and roster mismatches. Checked records cannot be forged through their public signature; Symbology.notes exposes informational colour fallbacks. Team-vs-allegiance colouring is chosen per scene. Absolute checked frame size reaches Glyphs lowering, avoiding the proof's mismatch between a declared 40-unit frame and a default 24-unit drawing. Facing reaches the glyph library's explicit missing-stroked-profile diagnostic; it is not qualified orientation rendering (#773 remains the supplier).

The rival experimental colour/theme/grammar modules are retired. ThemeExample.fs is the arena-like worked example using the package API and a theme reader, separate from game state. The numerical fuzz compiles the canonical production Theme sources directly so its full-domain digest observes internal ThemeGrid without widening the public API. It preserves the review fixtures as input intentions translated to the public quantised seed API. CI runs this numerical gate independently from browser smoke. The browser theme section uses production recipes and explicitly compares actual SVG/Pixi decided readbacks for each preset, in addition to per-backend, swap, A/B/A and monochrome controls.

Not established by this source candidate: browser pixel qualification, identical Babylon pixels, Windows CI, package publication, template adoption, RuneScape migration or Delivery completion. Calibration thresholds remain provisional pending size/player studies. #810 plan aliases remain a future additive proposal; no aliases beyond the current 35 are admitted here. The owning issue records the scoped theme-owner contrast/keyline/monochrome amendment. After source merge, #795's owner/Root must supersede candidate citations with immutable main citations; this is an explicit capture gap, not a claim of delivered knowledge.
title: Accepted theme-machinery design and production candidate: one Theme contract, checked Symbology and deterministic presets
